fresh_counterexamples.root_cause: Both implementations lowercase the whole source with Unicode String.toLowerCase(), then reuse indexes from that folded string against the original string. U+0130 expands from one UTF-16 code unit to two under lowercase, so the appropriate raw end tag is searched at a shifted index and missed.
